title: Cart Caverns
tagline: State that survives across pages - and the assertions that pin it down.
teaches: Multi-step journeys, counting rows, quantities, removal, and asserting a thing is GONE
objectives: Carry state across three pages without letting the test lose track of what it added
Count rows with to_have_count() instead of reading a number out of the page and trusting it
Assert a row's quantity and price by scoping to that row, not to the whole table
Prove a removal happened with not_to_be_visible() - the check most suites forget
Recognise the moment a test has grown too long to read, which is the door to Zone 6
plannedChallenges: Add one product and prove it landed
Add two, and count the rows
Scope to one row: the right price on the right line
Change the quantity on the product page and check it survived
Fix the broken test: it asserts on the wrong row
Remove it, and prove it is gone
Boss: rebuild Test Case 17, add and remove with both states proved
